description: Use this when one specific facility is identified (a record_key slug from find_facility, or a license number the user gave) and the user wants its license status, published inspection counts or the agency's inspection findings. Returns the record with verbatim findings, the status-as-of date, the agency's official record link and the CheckedCare page URL. Do not use it to grade, rank or compare facilities, or to look up staff, children or any other individual.

license_number.description: The agency license or operation number, exactly as published.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (for example TX) of the state whose records to read. If the state is not covered, the tool returns an error naming the covered states.

name: get_facility_record
title: Get a facility's official record
